chunks: They said: 'By God, God has favoured you above us, for we have indeed been sinners.'
ai.seo_question: What did Joseph's brothers say to acknowledge his superiority and their own mistake?
ai.summary: In this verse, the brothers of Prophet Joseph (عليه السلام) confess their guilt upon recognizing his elevated status, marking a pivotal moment of repentance before their final reconciliation. Shia scholars highlight this as an example of sincere acknowledgment of divine favor and personal fault, illustrating the transition from arrogance to humility. Their admission underscores the theme of divine justice and mercy, as God’s plan ultimately prevails despite human errors.
